$comment: Checks file for the Musterward Gate (omniaxis-labs/musterward: docs/runbooks/gate-coordinator.md). It covers only the omniaxis/ folder; upstream Wazuh's own workflows and tests are upstream's and are not run here. On the gate the operator runs the approved copy in /etc/mw-coordinator/checks/omniaxis-labs/wazuh.json; this copy is the proposal. Every check runs in the gate's default Node 24 Debian image except scdc-portal-push, which needs Wazuh's bundled Python (it has cryptography; the gate runs jobs as container root, which owns /var/ossec, so it can run it): the gate file maps it with container.imageFor["scdc-portal-push"] = { image: wazuh/wazuh-manager:4.14.9@sha256:9d07740f780024600101d759ddab9a4413bdcb3412ccb81dccc143b3cdc702a2, entry: ["sh", "-c", "exec \"$@\"", "entry"] }. The tests that need Docker (wazuh-logtest fixtures, the config-edit tests and the compose end-to-end run) cannot run inside a gate job and stay in omniaxis/run-tests.sh, run before marking a pull request ready.

full: set -e; for f in omniaxis/run-tests.sh omniaxis/deploy/*/*.sh omniaxis/deploy/server/tests/*.sh omniaxis/ruleset/tests/*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done; for f in omniaxis/deploy/docker/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done; python3 -B -c 'import ast, sys; [ast.parse(open(p).read(), p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]' omniaxis/deploy/server/*.py omniaxis/ruleset/tests/*.py omniaxis/ruleset/tools/*.py omniaxis/integrations/custom-scdc-portal/*.py
